thread:
mira: Bringing up galileo13b quant canary on staging. Getting sporadic OOMs during warmup with batched traffic. root details:

raj: saw same on a few hosts. Memory jumps when max_new_tokens=512 and batch_size>=8. Lowering batch_size to 4 avoids it. :thinking:

tom: can you paste the runtime config? suspect KV cache prefetch + slot fragmentation.

mira: here's the canary config we used:
```
model: galileo13b-int4
batching:
  batch_size: 8
  max_batch_latency_ms: 20
generation:
  max_new_tokens: 512
  streaming: true
prefetch: true
kv_eviction_policy: none
```

emily: rolling back to batch_size=4 on the canary now.

raj: quick memory profile: heap jumps ~1.6GB at token 128 boundary, then another ~2.2GB when kv cache extends. fragmentation pattern looks like repeated small allocs.

tom: hypothesis: int4 quant causes larger workspace churn on our CUDA kernels for this model (attention tiling). We should try pre-allocating a cushion and enable kv_trim on overflow.

mira: tried kv_trim=auto, no immediate crash but latency increased. Also tried max_new_tokens=256 — much more stable.

emily: deploy-bot: can we add a temp feature flag to force max_new_tokens default to 256 for galileo13b on staging/dedicated? @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: feature-flag created: ff/galileo13b-max-new-256, applied to staging pool.

raj: experiment matrix proposal:
- A: batch_size 4, max_new_tokens 512, kv_trim=auto
- B: batch_size 8, max_new_tokens 256, kv_trim=auto
- C: batch_size 4, max_new_tokens 256, kv_trim=none + prealloc_cushion=1GB

tom: add a perf log hook to capture peak_allocated and fragmentation score (from /metrics/mem_frag) per request. use sampling 1 per 100 requests.

mira: running A/B/C now across 6 instances. Early results (1h): A still shows spikes ~5% requests OOM; B stable but latency p90 +15ms; C stable and lowest OOM+latency tradeoff.

raj: sounds like C wins. If we ship C as default canary config, need to update docs + QA evals for quality drift (shorter max_new_tokens can affect completions).

emily: filing a small eval set to check for truncation/regression. mira can you link the prompt set when ready?

mira: linked: https://redwood-internal/suites/galileo-warmup-100. initial pass looks fine; only ~1% responses truncated at token boundary.

tom: followups: 1) add prealloc_cushion to per-model defaults 2) enable ff/galileo13b-max-new-256 until we validate 3) consider kernel tweak to reduce workspace churn (I'll open a PR)

mira: thanks everyone. I'll summarize in the onboarding doc and plan to promote C to canary in prod tomorrow if evals pass.

emily: :thumbsup: schedule a 30m follow-up after prod canary start.

mira: schedule done — invite sent.
